title: Bouts with a heavy favourite, by year
alt: Line chart: share of UFC bouts with a heavy favourite (75% or better). 10.8% in 2021, 16.9% in 2022, 19.4% in 2023, 21.6% in 2024, 24.8% in 2025, and 28.2% in 2026 so far, through 19 September. The 2027 call is above 30%.
footnote: * 2026 is partial, through 19 Sep, bouts with odds only (87%). Source: First Light Observatory.
